files.prisma/schema.prisma:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../app/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

enum ChallengeType {
  CLOSEST_TO_PIN
  LONGEST_DRIVE
}

enum ChallengeStatus {
  DRAFT
  ACTIVE
  PAUSED
  COMPLETED
}

enum EntryStatus {
  PENDING_PAYMENT
  PAID
  READY
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
  DISQUALIFIED
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCEEDED
  FAILED
  REFUNDED
}

enum PrizeStatus {
  AVAILABLE
  AWARDED
  PAID_OUT
}

enum SimulatorProvider {
  TRUGOLF_APOGEE_E6
  E6_CONNECT
  FLIGHTSCOPE_E6
  MANUAL
  OTHER
}

enum SimulatorSessionStatus {
  CREATED
  OPERATOR_READY
  LAUNCHED
  IN_PROGRESS
  RESULT_PENDING
  VERIFIED
  SYNCED
  CANCELLED
}

enum SimulatorResultSource {
  MANUAL_ENTRY
  SCREENSHOT
  CSV_IMPORT
  LOCAL_AGENT
  VENDOR_API
}

enum SimulatorResultStatus {
  PENDING_REVIEW
  VERIFIED
  REJECTED
  SYNCED
}

model User {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  name            String
  username        String    @unique
  email           String    @unique
  phone           String?
  simulatorDisplayName String?
  passwordHash    String
  emailVerifiedAt DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt

  entries                 Entry[]
  payments                Payment[]
  emailVerificationTokens EmailVerificationToken[]
  passwordResetTokens     PasswordResetToken[]
  playerSessions          PlayerSession[]
  accountConsentRecords   AccountConsentRecord[]
  adminSessions           AdminSession[]
  adminLoginChallenges    AdminLoginChallenge[]
  privacyRequests         PrivacyRequest[]
  participationHold       ParticipationHold?
}

model ParticipationHold {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String   @unique
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  status          String   @default("Active")
  reason          String
  heldById        String
  heldByEmail     String
  releasedById    String?
  releasedByEmail String?
  releasedAt      DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
  events          ParticipationHoldEvent[]

  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

model ParticipationHoldEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  holdId     String
  hold       ParticipationHold @relation(fields: [holdId], references: [id])
  actorId    String
  actorEmail String
  action     String
  reason     String
  customerNotifiedAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([holdId, createdAt])
}

model PrivacyRequest {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId           String?
  user             User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  email            String
  requestType      String
  relatedRequestId String?
  detail           String
  status           String   @default("Received")
  identityStatus   String   @default("Account Verified")
  dueAt            DateTime
  extensionReason  String?
  extendedAt       DateTime?
  decision         String?
  response         String?
  fulfillmentReference String?
  handledById      String?
  handledByEmail   String?
  resolvedAt       DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt
  events           PrivacyRequestEvent[]

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, dueAt])
}

model PrivacyRequestEvent {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  requestId     String
  request       PrivacyRequest @relation(fields: [requestId], references: [id])
  actorId       String
  actorEmail    String
  action        String
  note          String?
  customerText  String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  deliveries    PrivacyRequestEmailDelivery[]

  @@index([requestId, createdAt])
}

model PrivacyRequestEmailDelivery {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  eventId   String
  event     PrivacyRequestEvent @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id])
  audience  String
  sentAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([eventId, audience])
}

model AdminLoginChallenge {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  codeHash  String
  smsVerificationId String?
  attempts  Int       @default(0)
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, expiresAt])
  @@index([expiresAt, usedAt])
}

model AdminSession {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  tokenHash         String   @unique
  lastActivityAt    DateTime @default(now())
  expiresAt         DateTime
  absoluteExpiresAt DateTime
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([absoluteExpiresAt])
}

model SecurityRateLimitBucket {
  key             String   @id
  namespace       String
  requestCount    Int
  windowStartedAt DateTime
  expiresAt       DateTime
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([namespace, expiresAt])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model AccountConsentRecord {
  id                     String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId                 String
  documentVersion        String
  acceptanceText         Json
  documentHashes         Json
  combinedDocumentHash   String
  legalDocumentsAccepted Boolean
  age18Accepted          Boolean
  texasResidencyAccepted Boolean
  acceptedAt             DateTime
  ipAddress              String?
  userAgent              String?
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, acceptedAt])
  @@index([documentVersion, acceptedAt])
}

model PlayerSession {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId         String
  tokenHash      String   @unique
  lastActivityAt DateTime @default(now())
  expiresAt      DateTime
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model EmailVerificationToken {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  email     String
  tokenHash String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, expiresAt])
}

model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  tokenHash String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, expiresAt])
}

model Location {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  slug      String   @unique
  address   String?
  city      String?
  state     String?
  websiteUrl String?
  bookingUrl String?
  simulatorProvider SimulatorProvider @default(OTHER)
  simulatorSoftwareName String?
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  bays       Bay[]
  challenges Challenge[]
  payments   Payment[]
  simulatorSessions SimulatorSession[]
}

model BookingLinkClick {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  locationId   String?
  locationSlug String
  locationName String
  bookingUrl   String
  referrer     String?
  userAgent    String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([locationSlug, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model QrScan {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  challengeSlug String
  locationSlug  String
  bayName       String?
  bookingMatchStatus String?
  bookingVerificationId String?
  referrer      String?
  userAgent     String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([locationSlug, createdAt])
  @@index([bookingMatchStatus, createdAt])
  @@index([challengeSlug, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model BookingVerification {
  id                  String   @id
  customerName        String
  customerEmail       String
  customerPhone       String?
  locationSlug        String
  locationName        String
  bayName             String?
  productName         String
  reservationStartsAt DateTime
  reservationEndsAt   DateTime?
  amountCents         Int?
  source              String
  externalReference   String?
  rawEmailSubject     String?
  rawEmailText        String?
  status              String
  matchedEntryId      String?
  usedAt              DateTime?
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([locationSlug, reservationStartsAt])
  @@index([customerEmail, reservationStartsAt])
  @@index([status, reservationStartsAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model SquareCheckout {
  id                      String   @id
  playerEmail             String
  challengeSlug           String
  playerName              String
  phoneNumber             String
  e6DisplayName           String
  locationSlug            String?
  locationName            String?
  bayName                 String?
  amountCents             Int
  status                  String
  squareOrderId           String   @unique
  squarePaymentLinkId     String?
  squarePaymentLinkUrl    String
  squarePaymentId         String?
  squarePaidAt             DateTime?
  acceptedConsentRecordId  String?
  acceptedDocumentVersion  String?
  acceptedPackageHash      String?
  entryId                 String?
  refundStatus            String   @default("None")
  refundedAmountCents     Int      @default(0)
  accessRevealedAt        DateTime?
  confirmationEmailSentAt String?
  staffEmailSentAt        DateTime?
  playerEmailSentAt       DateTime?
  reconciledAt            DateTime?
  createdAt               DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([playerEmail, createdAt])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([reconciledAt, createdAt])
}

model PaymentIssueClaim {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  systemIssueKey     String?  @unique
  checkoutId         String
  entryId            String?
  playerId           String
  playerEmail        String
  reason             String
  venueName          String?
  incidentAt         DateTime?
  narrative          String
  evidenceReference  String?
  lateSubmissionFlag Boolean  @default(false)
  status             String   @default("Open")
  assignedTo         String?
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt
  events             PaymentIssueEvent[]
  evidenceFiles      PaymentIssueEvidence[]
  refund             SquareRefundAttempt?

  @@index([playerId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([checkoutId])
}

model PaymentIssueEvidence {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  claimId         String
  claim           PaymentIssueClaim @relation(fields: [claimId], references: [id])
  uploadedById    String
  originalName    String
  mimeType        String
  sizeBytes       Int
  sha256          String
  content         Bytes
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([claimId, createdAt])
}

model PaymentIssueEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  claimId    String
  claim      PaymentIssueClaim @relation(fields: [claimId], references: [id])
  actorId    String
  actorEmail String
  action     String
  note       String?
  customerMessage String?
  meta       Json?
  deliveries PaymentIssueEmailDelivery[]
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([claimId, createdAt])
}

model PaymentIssueEmailDelivery {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  eventId   String
  event     PaymentIssueEvent @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id])
  audience  String
  sentAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([eventId, audience])
}

model SquareRefundAttempt {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  claimId          String   @unique
  claim            PaymentIssueClaim @relation(fields: [claimId], references: [id])
  checkoutId       String
  paymentId        String
  amountCents      Int
  idempotencyKey   String   @unique
  providerRefundId String?  @unique
  providerStatus   String   @default("Reserved")
  lastCheckedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([checkoutId])
  @@index([providerStatus, createdAt])
}

model PaymentReconciliationIssue {
  key           String    @id
  type          String
  checkoutId    String?
  entryId       String?
  status        String    @default("Open")
  detail        String
  customerEmail String?
  customerNotifiedAt DateTime?
  lastAlertedAt DateTime?
  resolvedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([checkoutId])
  @@index([entryId])
}

model TransactionAuditEventRecord {
  id         String   @id
  checkoutId String
  provider   String
  event      String
  status     String
  meta       Json?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([checkoutId, createdAt])
  @@index([event, createdAt])
}

model OperatingCost {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  incurredAt    DateTime
  vendor        String
  category      String
  description   String?
  amountCents   Int
  paymentMethod String?
  account       String?
  isDeductible  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([incurredAt])
  @@index([category, incurredAt])
  @@index([isDeductible, incurredAt])
}

model ClubhouseEntryRecord {
  id                            String   @id
  challengeSlug                 String
  playerName                    String
  playerEmail                   String?
  phoneNumber                   String?
  e6DisplayName                 String
  paymentStatus                 String
  refundStatus                  String   @default("None")
  refundedAmountCents           Int      @default(0)
  paidAt                        String
  validFrom                     String
  validUntil                    String
  attemptLimit                  Int
  resultStatus                  String
  result                        String?
  resultValue                   Float?
  resultUnit                    String?
  evidence                      String?
  e6EventCode                   String
  stripeCheckoutSessionId       String?  @unique
  payarcCheckoutId              String?  @unique
  payarcOrderId                 String?
  squareCheckoutId              String?  @unique
  squareOrderId                 String?
  squarePaymentId               String?
  acceptedConsentRecordId       String?
  acceptedDocumentVersion       String?
  acceptedPackageHash           String?
  paymentReconciledAt            DateTime?
  holeInOneReport                HoleInOneReport?
  venueBookingReference         String?
  bookingVerificationId         String?
  bookingVerificationStatus     String?
  paymentMethod                 String
  locationSlug                  String
  locationName                  String
  bayName                       String?
  amountCents                   Int
  adminConfirmedAt              String?
  adminConfirmedBy              String?
  entryDecisionStatus           String?
  entryDecisionAt               String?
  entryDecisionBy               String?
  entryDecisionEmailSentAt      String?
  archivedAt                    DateTime?
  archivedBy                    String?
  archiveReason                 String?
  createdAt                     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt                     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([challengeSlug, createdAt])
  @@index([locationSlug, createdAt])
  @@index([paymentStatus, createdAt])
  @@index([entryDecisionStatus, createdAt])
  @@index([archivedAt, createdAt])
  @@index([paymentReconciledAt, createdAt])
}

model Bay {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  name       String
  qrCodeUrl  String?
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  locationId String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  location   Location    @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])
  challenges Challenge[]
  entries    Entry[]
  simulatorSessions SimulatorSession[]

  @@unique([locationId, name])
}

model Challenge {
  id          String          @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  type        ChallengeType
  status      ChallengeStatus @default(DRAFT)
  entryFee    Int             @default(2000)
  startsAt    DateTime?
  endsAt      DateTime?
  locationId  String
  bayId       String?
  createdAt   DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime        @updatedAt

  location    Location      @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])
  bay         Bay?          @relation(fields: [bayId], references: [id])
  entries     Entry[]
  leaderboard Leaderboard?
  prizes      Prize[]
  simulatorSessions SimulatorSession[]
}

model ClubhouseChallengeSetting {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  challengeSlug String  @unique
  e6EventCode String?
  salesState  String   @default("Open")
  salesHoldReason String?
  salesHeldAt DateTime?
  startsAt    DateTime?
  endsAt      DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model HoleInOneReport {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  challengeSlug       String
  entryId             String    @unique
  status              String    @default("Pending Review")
  reportSource        String
  reportedBy          String
  playerStatement     String?
  evidenceReference   String?
  simulatorProvider   String?
  simulatorSessionId  String?
  simulatorShotId     String?
  simulatorAlias      String?
  simulatorVenue      String?
  simulatorBay        String?
  strokeCount         Int?
  ballHoled           Boolean?
  designatedTee       Boolean?
  shotAt              DateTime?
  timestampReliable   Boolean?
  verifiedBy          String?
  verifiedAt          DateTime?
  reviewNote          String?
  reportedAt          DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt

  entry  ClubhouseEntryRecord @relation(fields: [entryId], references: [id])
  events HoleInOneReviewEvent[]
  winnerClaim WinnerClaim?

  @@unique([simulatorProvider, simulatorShotId])
  @@index([challengeSlug, status, shotAt])
}

model HoleInOneReviewEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  reportId  String
  actorId   String
  actorEmail String?
  action    String
  note      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  report HoleInOneReport @relation(fields: [reportId], references: [id])

  @@index([reportId, createdAt])
}

model WinnerChronology {
  challengeSlug       String   @id
  status              String   @default("No Verified Result")
  provisionalReportId String?
  decidedAt           DateTime?
  updatedAt           DateTime @updatedAt
}

model WinnerClaim {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  reportId           String   @unique
  report             HoleInOneReport @relation(fields: [reportId], references: [id])
  challengeSlug      String
  entryId            String
  playerEmail        String
  status             String   @default("Potential Winner")
  noticeSentAt       DateTime?
  responseDueAt      DateTime?
  respondedAt        DateTime?
  responseStatus     String   @default("Awaiting")
  eligibilityStatus  String   @default("Pending")
  identityStatus     String   @default("Not received")
  residencyStatus    String   @default("Not received")
  affidavitStatus    String   @default("Not received")
  w9Status           String   @default("Not received")
  secureCollectionMethod String?
  finalizedAt        DateTime?
  payoutTargetAt     DateTime?
  payoutApprovedAt   DateTime?
  payoutApprovedBy   String?
  payoutAmountCents  Int?
  paidAt             DateTime?
  payoutMethod       String?
  taxFormStatus      String   @default("CPA review pending")
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt
  events             WinnerClaimEvent[]

  @@index([challengeSlug, status])
  @@index([responseDueAt])
}

model WinnerClaimEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  claimId     String
  claim       WinnerClaim @relation(fields: [claimId], references: [id])
  actorId     String
  actorEmail  String
  action      String
  note        String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([claimId, createdAt])
}

model Entry {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  status      EntryStatus @default(PENDING_PAYMENT)
  entryNumber Int?
  userId      String
  challengeId String
  bayId       String?
  paymentId   String?     @unique
  createdAt   DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime    @updatedAt

  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  challenge Challenge @relation(fields: [challengeId], references: [id])
  bay       Bay?      @relation(fields: [bayId], references: [id])
  payment   Payment?  @relation(fields: [paymentId], references: [id])
  shots     Shot[]
  simulatorSessions SimulatorSession[]

  @@index([challengeId, status])
}

model Shot {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  entryId           String
  shotNumber        Int
  carryYards        Decimal? @db.Decimal(7, 2)
  totalYards        Decimal? @db.Decimal(7, 2)
  distanceToPinInch Decimal? @db.Decimal(8, 2)
  isHoleInOne       Boolean  @default(false)
  notes             String?
  enteredBy         String?
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())

  entry Entry @relation(fields: [entryId], references: [id])

  @@unique([entryId, shotNumber])
}

model Leaderboard {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  challengeId String   @unique
  standings   Json
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  challenge Challenge @relation(fields: [challengeId], references: [id])
}

model Payment {
  id                     String        @id @default(cuid())
  userId                 String
  amount                 Int
  currency               String        @default("usd")
  status                 PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  stripeCheckoutSessionId String?       @unique
  stripePaymentIntentId   String?       @unique
  locationId              String?
  createdAt              DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime      @updatedAt

  user     User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  location Location? @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])
  entry    Entry?

  @@index([locationId, createdAt])
}

model Prize {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  challengeId String
  name        String
  value       Int?
  status      PrizeStatus @default(AVAILABLE)
  winnerId    String?
  awardedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime    @updatedAt

  challenge Challenge @relation(fields: [challengeId], references: [id])
}

model SimulatorDevice {
  id                  String            @id @default(cuid())
  provider            SimulatorProvider @default(TRUGOLF_APOGEE_E6)
  venueName           String
  bayName             String
  softwareName        String?
  softwareVersion     String?
  launchMonitorModel  String?
  launchMonitorSerial String?
  firmwareVersion     String?
  operatorPcName      String?
  notes               String?
  isActive            Boolean           @default(true)
  createdAt           DateTime          @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime          @updatedAt

  sessions SimulatorSession[]

  @@index([provider, venueName, bayName])
}

model SimulatorSession {
  id                 String                 @id @default(cuid())
  pin2WinSessionId   String                 @unique
  provider           SimulatorProvider      @default(TRUGOLF_APOGEE_E6)
  status             SimulatorSessionStatus @default(CREATED)
  challengeType      ChallengeType
  playerAlias        String?
  operatorName       String?
  venueName          String?
  bayName            String?
  course             String?
  hole               Int?
  teeBox             String?
  pinLocation        String?
  attempts           Int?
  playTimeMinutes    Int?
  e6SessionName      String?
  e6SessionId        String?
  externalSessionId  String?
  syncEligible       Boolean                @default(false)
  launchInstructions Json?
  rawMetadata        Json?
  createdAt          DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime               @updatedAt
  launchedAt         DateTime?
  completedAt        DateTime?

  deviceId    String?
  locationId  String?
  bayId       String?
  challengeId String?
  entryId     String?

  device    SimulatorDevice? @relation(fields: [deviceId], references: [id])
  location  Location?        @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])
  bay       Bay?             @relation(fields: [bayId], references: [id])
  challenge Challenge?       @relation(fields: [challengeId], references: [id])
  entry     Entry?           @relation(fields: [entryId], references: [id])
  results   SimulatorResult[]

  @@index([status, provider])
  @@index([challengeType, createdAt])
}

model SimulatorResult {
  id                  String                @id @default(cuid())
  sessionId           String
  source              SimulatorResultSource @default(MANUAL_ENTRY)
  status              SimulatorResultStatus @default(PENDING_REVIEW)
  challengeType       ChallengeType
  playerAlias         String?
  rawResult           String
  resultUnit          String
  totalYards          Decimal?              @db.Decimal(7, 2)
  distanceToPinInches Decimal?              @db.Decimal(8, 2)
  evidenceUrl         String?
  verifierName        String?
  notes               String?
  rawPayload          Json?
  createdAt           DateTime              @default(now())
  verifiedAt          DateTime?
  syncedAt            DateTime?

  session SimulatorSession @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])

  @@index([challengeType, status])
  @@index([sessionId, createdAt])
}
